jobgether-jobgether:lever:60bdf15f-0803-.title: Senior Accounts Receivable & Revenue Operations Specialist
jobgether-jobgether:lever:60bdf15f-0803-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Accounts Receivable & Revenue Operations Specialist based in Canada. This role offers the opportunity to take ownership of critical revenue operations within a fast-paced, remote startup environment. You will manage the revenue cycle end-to-end, ensuring accuracy and efficiency from quoting through collections. The position combines accounts receivable expertise with systems optimization, reporting, automation, and process improvement. You will work closely with accounting, sales, and customers to resolve billing issues and maintain strong financial operations. Your ability to identify discrepancies, improve workflows, and strengthen financial controls will directly support business growth. The role is ideal for a proactive finance professional who enjoys autonomy, problem-solving, and evolving priorities. You will have the opportunity to contribute to scalable processes while working with modern accounting and payment technologies. Lead end-to-end revenue operations, covering quote generation, invoicing, reconciliation, receivables tracking, and timely collections. Review invoices and billing information against order forms, investigate discrepancies, and coordinate resolutions with sales teams and customers. Respond to customer and sales inquiries regarding invoices, billing issues, and payment status while taking ownership of the collections process. Support accurate revenue reporting by collaborating with accounting teams and reviewing SQL query outputs for accuracy and consistency. Manage and optimize financial systems such as QuickBooks Online and Stripe, including system upgrades, automation initiatives, and workflow improvements. Identify opportunities to streamline revenue processes, strengthen operational controls, and improve the overall quote-to-cash cycle. Communicate clearly and professionally with customers and internal stakeholders regarding billing, collections, and financial matters. Work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with accounting, sales, and other operational teams. Requirements 2+ years of accounting experience within U.S.-based companies, with a strong focus on Accounts Receivable and Revenue Operations. Demonstrated experience managing the complete revenue cycle from quote to cash. Advanced proficiency with QuickBooks Online and Stripe, with the ability to review SQL query outputs and identify potential inaccuracies. Strong reconciliation and problem-solving skills, including the confidence to challenge discrepancies and push back appropriately with customers or sales teams. Experience implementing process improvements, system upgrades, and automation projects within accounting or revenue operations. Familiarity with startup accounting environments and the ability to adapt effectively to changing priorities. Experience with tools such as Slack, Google Drive, Google Sheets, Mercury, Chase, Ramp, Brex, Bill.com, or ClickUp is a plus. Professional fluency in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills. Highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and trustworthy, with a strong sense of ownership and integrity. Comfortable working independently while also contributing effectively within a collaborative team. Coachable and eager to continuously improve processes, systems, and professional capabilities. General awareness of how AI is being applied to accounting and operational workflows is an advantage. Benefits Competitive salary paid in USD per month, based on experience. Unlimited paid vacation days per year. All U.S. national holidays included. Fully remote opportunity with the flexibility to work from anywhere in the world. Opportunity to work in a fast-paced startup environment with evolving priorities. Professional growth and learning opportunities. Supportive and collaborative working environment. jobgether-jobgether:lever:a08761e7-9e5c-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Utility Data Programmer Analyst based in the United States. This fully remote role supports data-intensive projects across electric, gas, and water utilities, with an initial focus on large-scale asset-data validation. You will transform complex information from GIS, asset management, inspection, maintenance, and operational systems into reliable, actionable insights. The position combines SQL development, data quality analysis, business intelligence, data integration, and utility-domain knowledge. You will work alongside project managers, engineers, GIS specialists, utility subject matter experts, and data analysts in a multidisciplinary consulting environment. Your work will directly support asset accuracy, regulatory initiatives, operational analytics, and process improvement for utility clients. The role offers opportunities to automate recurring workflows, build analytical solutions, and improve the reliability and traceability of critical infrastructure data. It is well suited to a technically strong analyst who enjoys solving complex data problems and communicating findings to diverse stakeholders. Analyze large and complex datasets originating from utility systems such as GIS, enterprise asset management, work management, inspection, maintenance, and operational databases. Develop SQL queries, scripts, and repeatable workflows to extract, join, transform, validate, and reconcile data across multiple sources. Identify and investigate data-quality issues, including missing records, duplicate assets, inconsistent attributes, invalid relationships, and discrepancies between systems. Support the validation and reconciliation of asset records across platforms such as GIS, SAP, inspection systems, and document repositories. Create dashboards, reports, performance metrics, and other analytical products using Power BI or comparable business intelligence tools. Build and maintain analytical workflows within Palantir Foundry or similar cloud-based data integration and analytics platforms. Translate operational, engineering, business, and regulatory requirements into structured data specifications and analytical procedures. Automate recurring data-processing, quality-control, and reporting activities where appropriate to improve efficiency and consistency. Document data sources, business rules, assumptions, calculations, validation procedures, and analytical findings to ensure traceability. Produce clear summaries of data issues, root causes, trends, risks, and recommended corrective actions for both technical and nontechnical audiences. Collaborate with utility stakeholders and project teams to resolve data questions and improve the completeness, accuracy, and reliability of asset information. Support project tracking, quality assurance, client reporting, and preparation of project deliverables. Handle sensitive utility and client information in accordance with confidentiality, cybersecurity, and data-governance requirements. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, computer science, information systems, engineering, geography, mathematics, statistics, or a related discipline. Demonstrated experience analyzing complex datasets using SQL and relational database concepts. Working knowledge of data structures, joins, keys, relationships, normalization, and data-quality controls. Experience developing dashboards, reports, or analytical products with Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable platform. Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including advanced formulas, pivot tables, data validation, and analysis of large datasets. Ability to translate business and operational requirements into structured analytical methods and repeatable processes. Our partner is looking for a Senior Internal Auditor based in United States. You will execute audits, assess risks, validate remediation efforts, and provide practical recommendations to management. The role combines traditional audit expertise with exposure to technology, data analytics, AI, and financial technology. Our partner is looking for a Property Management Account Manager based in Kenya. This is a fully remote opportunity for an experienced property management professional to take ownership of a diverse portfolio and its day-to-day operations. You’ll serve as a key point of contact for clients and tenants, building strong relationships while ensuring properties are managed efficiently. The role combines operational oversight, communication, team coordination, and independent problem-solving. You’ll be expected to navigate complex situations that may not have straightforward answers, using sound judgment and a proactive mindset. responsibilities: Supervise field crews installing stairs, railings, and miscellaneous metal components.
Coordinate daily work activities with the General Contractor.
Review blueprints and ensure accurate layout and installation.
Plan crew assignments and coordinate required materials, tools, and equipment.
Verify employee certifications and enforce job-site safety requirements.
Complete daily field and vehicle inspection reports.
Monitor and maintain tools, equipment, and company service vehicles.
Act as the on-site safety representative and enforce PPE and project-specific safety procedures.
Lead Tool-Box Shop Talks and reinforce general safety practices.
Monitor work progress and address field issues as needed.
qualifications: 5+ years of experience in miscellaneous metals or a related field preferred.
Previous Foreman or supervisory experience strongly preferred.
Ability to read and interpret construction blueprints and safety documentation.
Strong basic math skills, including working with angles, degrees, and standard measurements.
Working knowledge of AWS D1.1 .
Familiarity with SMAW, FCAW, GMAW, and GTAW welding processes.
Current welding certifications or the ability to successfully pass a weld test.
Strong leadership, communication, organization, and safety skills.
